verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents a native, first-party MCP server at the POST /mcp route that any MCP-compatible client can connect to. Through it, agents can create indexes, add documents, configure settings such as ranking rules and faceting, and run searches via natural-language prompts. A dedicated MCP integration page and a probe confirming the docs page back this up. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as documented.
